items.name: Spanish Elections - Others
items.description: The main objective of this dataset is to offer analysts and scholars of the electoral phenomenon and society in general a centralized place where to find, in an organized and homogeneous way, the results recorded in the electoral processes of elections in Spain. As well as, new databases obtained through spatial and/or temporal combination of them and/or with other related datasets.
